# TurboTenant

> > All-in-one property management platform helping 1M+ landlords screen tenants, manage leases, collect rent, and advertise properties.

TurboTenant is a comprehensive landlord software suite combining tenant screening, lease management, rent collection, and property listing tools. The platform integrates with major listing sites like Apartments.com, Realtor.com, and Rent.com, and offers both self-service and full-service (Autopilot) management options.

## Key Topics

- Property Management Software
- Tenant Screening
- Rent Collection
- Lease Management
- Rental Advertising
- E-Signature
- Tenant Communication
- Rental Applications
- Condition Reports
- AI Lease Audit
- Rent Reporting
- Landlord Accounting
- Autopilot (Full-Service)
- Showing Scheduling
- Maintenance Management

## Core Platform & Features

- [Property Management Software | TurboTenant](https://www.turbotenant.com): TurboTenant homepage: 1M+ landlords use platform for tenant screening, leases, rent collection.
- [Property Management Software Features | TurboTenant](https://www.turbotenant.com/features): Overview of TurboTenant's core features for tenant screening, lease management, and rent collection.
- [Premium Plan - All-in-One Landlord Software | TurboTenant](https://www.turbotenant.com/premium): Premium pricing tier offering all-in-one landlord software for property management.

## Tenant Screening & Applications

- [Tenant Background Checks & Screening Services | TurboTenant](https://www.turbotenant.com/tenant-screening): Tenant background checks with credit, criminal, and eviction reports for reliable tenant vetting.
- [Free Rental Application - Online Forms & Templates | TurboTenant](https://www.turbotenant.com/rental-application): Free online rental application forms for tenant screening and onboarding process.
- [Protect Your Investment - TurboTenant](https://www.turbotenant.com/protect-your-investment): Guide on tenant screening, landlord insurance, and renters insurance for investment protection.

## Lease & Document Management

- [Create a Lease Agreement in 15 Minutes or Less | TurboTenant](https://www.turbotenant.com/rental-lease-agreement): Customizable lease agreement templates with state-specific compliance and e-signature.
- [Best E-Sign Tool for Landlords | TurboTenant](https://www.turbotenant.com/esign): Affordable e-signature tool for landlords to sign leases and rental documents electronically.
- [Lease Ai Audit Software | TurboTenant](https://www.turbotenant.com/landlord-toolbox/lease-agreement-audit-ai): AI-powered lease agreement audit tool for compliance checks in 15 seconds.
- [Free Landlord Rental Agreement Forms | PDF Templates](https://www.turbotenant.com/landlord-toolbox/rental-forms): Free PDF templates for rental agreements, condition reports, and landlord forms pack.
- [Rental Property Condition Report | TurboTenant](https://www.turbotenant.com/condition-reports): Digital condition reports and move-in/move-out checklists to prevent security deposit disputes.

## Rent Collection & Accounting

- [Collect Rent Online | Best Rent Collection Software for Landlords](https://www.turbotenant.com/collect-rent-payments-online): Rent collection app with recurring payments, reminders, and multiple payment methods.
- [TurboTenant: Landlord Rental Accounting Software](https://www.turbotenant.com/rental-accounting): Rental accounting software powered by REI Hub for bookkeeping and tax reporting.
- [TurboTenant Rent Reporter: Report Rent Payments, Build Your Credit Score](https://www.turbotenant.com/rent-reporting): Rent reporting service that helps tenants build credit by reporting to TransUnion.

## Rental Listing & Property Advertising

- [List Rental Property | Advertise Your Property for Rent Today](https://www.turbotenant.com/advertise-rental-property): Publish rental properties across dozens of listing sites including Apartments.com and Realtor.com.
- [Rental Showing Scheduling Software | TurboTenant](https://www.turbotenant.com/showing-scheduling): Free showing scheduling tool for landlords to set availability and manage tenant inquiries.

## Tenant Communication & Operations

- [In-App Messaging for Landlords | TurboTenant](https://www.turbotenant.com/messages): Centralized in-app messaging hub for landlord-tenant communication and quick replies.
- [Rental Property Maintenance | Send Maintenance Requests](https://www.turbotenant.com/rental-property-maintenance): Streamline maintenance requests with AI diagnostics and vendor coordination tools.
- [Tenant Welcome Book | TurboTenant Home Guide](https://www.turbotenant.com/home-guide): Create free tenant welcome books to improve rental experience and tenant onboarding.

## Full-Service Management

- [Property Management Services | Autopilot](https://www.turbotenant.com/autopilot): TurboTenant Autopilot: Full-service property management with tenant placement and flat-fee pricing.
